The [[Clantaani]] gunslinger [[Longo Two-Guns]] established the '''Longo Two-Guns Gang''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] by [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="date">The events of ''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]'' take place in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> The gang consisted mainly of Two-Guns's cousins<ref name="BHSG">[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Bounty Hunter'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref> and long-time associates, such as [[Radd Hardwikk]]<ref name="CSWE II 19">{{CSWECite|II|19|Hardwikk, Radd}}.</ref> and [[Klintee|"Deadeye" Klintee]].<ref name="CSWE II 222">{{CSWECite|II|222|Klintee, "Deadeye"}}.</ref> The group also included hired [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]], [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]], and [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]]. Two-Guns and his cronies operated in the Outer Rim, with activities in such locales as [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]], [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]], and [[Mos Gamos]]. They made their living by raiding other criminal enterprises and stealing business from them,<ref name="BHSG" /> and by taking jobs from [[Gardulla Besadii the Elder/Legends|Gardulla]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]].<ref name="CSWE III 270">{{CSWECite|III|270|Two-Guns, Longo}}.</ref>
